mapper.update: update agent_task set status=#{status},updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
update agent_task set status=#{status},result_text=#{resultText},error_text=#{errorText},updated_at=now() where id=#{id} and status not in ('DONE','FAILED','CANCELLED')
update agent_task set plan_json=#{planJson},updated_at=now() where id=#{id}
mapper.select: select * from agent_task where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} limit 1
select * from agent_task where user_id=#{userId} order by created_at desc limit #{limit}
select * from agent_task_step where task_id=#{taskId} order by seq,id
select id from agent_task where status in ('RUNNING','AWAITING_CONFIRM') and updated_at < #{cutoff} order by updated_at limit 200
select status as "status", count(*) as "cnt" from agent_task where user_id=#{userId} group by status
select coalesce(avg(step_cnt), 0) from (select count(*) as step_cnt from agent_task_step s join agent_task t on s.task_id = t.id where t.user_id = #{userId} and s.kind = 'tool' group by s.task_id)
